items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: Oh yeah, with the Sydney Fluesa, we had a band with Rudolph.

ctx.x: Yeah, he didn't play in all the keys either, I don't think.

No, everything he played in the wrong key would start us up. And the record band done pretty good. There was a scab band, the record band, I'm going to tell you how it was. It was a scab band, and I belonged to the union, so they would be over at the Gypsy T-Room. When I would pass there, I had my boy playing clarinet in the band, and they wouldn't say nothing to me. I'd say, I'm teaching the band, and I'd get by with murder. Yeah. I'd pass there and I'd blow my clarinet all up in Williamson, fellas, they'd say,…
